name: Ireland
description: Ireland from Newgrange and the Celts to Saint Patrick, the monasteries, the Vikings, English rule, the famine, the Easter Rising and the republic.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Ireland
checkpoints.note: Farmers built Newgrange more than five thousand years ago. Celtic kingdoms followed, Saint Patrick brought Christianity, and monks made Ireland a land of saints and scholars.

checkpoints.name: Vikings and Normans
checkpoints.note: Vikings raided and founded Dublin. Normans from England came in 1169, and English rule slowly spread over the island.

checkpoints.name: Under Britain
checkpoints.note: Cromwell crushed the Catholics, the union of 1801 joined Ireland to Britain, and the Great Famine killed or drove away millions.

checkpoints.name: Independence
checkpoints.note: The Easter Rising of 1916 led to war and a free state in 1922. Ireland became a republic, the Troubles tore the north until 1998, and the Celtic Tiger made it rich.
